key_insight: High-dimensional GAN training with structured latent covariance collapses to deterministic ODEs governed by an effective probability-weighted second moment, revealing when correlated latent signals help or destabilize learning.
engineering_relevance: The results provide a practical stability map for tuning generator covariance and learning rates in GANs, helping engineers improve subspace recovery and representation alignment in data-driven models.
method: Linear generator learns a low-dimensional subspace from structured data
Quadratic energy discriminator with multi-feature, class-dependent latent covariance
High-dimensional stochastic training converges to deterministic ODEs via effective covariance
evidence_signal: Simulations validate the ODE dynamics, phase boundaries, and signal-boosting effect, and experiments on MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10 show improved alignment when generator covariance is informed by the data subspace.
watch_item: The stability and boosting effects depend on the matched-covariance assumptions and learning-rate/noise regime, so behavior may change in less controlled GAN settings.
paper_title: Effective Covariance Dynamics in Solvable High-Dimensional GANs
